source_of_truth.method: direct uploaded source decomposition, not inferred from memory

core_policy: 完成済み機能を新作品ごとに作り直さない
画面ブロック・機能ブロック・データブロックを分離
ブロックの組合せ・画像/文章/配色/BGM/地点差し替えを新作品作成の主目的とする
MAPは独立機能でありCHECKPOINT専用にしない
ルート概要を各地点間ルートの第一級データとして保持
公開プレビューと本番HTMLは同じランタイム生成関数を使う
未知の将来項目・ブロックを既存責務を壊さず追加可能にする
通常操作は順番式・iPhoneで読める文字サイズを維持
リリース時はアップファイル名とアップ後URLを必ず提示
map_editor_v8: facility/address search with multiple selectable results
route drawing between any two locations
legacy v15-style route JSON import including route/checkpoints/warnings/toilets/routeOverviews
known_limits: v8 decomposes the completed source and imports its core event data, but it is not yet a byte-for-byte extraction of every historical release patch function into isolated ES modules.
CHAT/LIVE runtime adapters remain foundation modules and are not rewritten in this release.
Automatic walking-route calculation is not introduced; saved/manual routes are authoritative to avoid Google walking-route detour regressions.
regression_checks: source template opens with 3 stages and current checkpoint/quizzes
new blank quest does not inherit old map data
route overview persists in project JSON and appears in runtime destination card
map can place location without search
legacy route JSON import does not delete unrelated blocks
theme/asset changes do not alter block order
completed source embedded images are available as replaceable asset slots
source block instances retain sourceRef traceability to release308 render functions

validation.note: Leaflet/Nominatim network behavior must be confirmed on GitHub Pages/iPhone because the container blocks external browser networking.
